import json, subprocess, sys
ev = []
for i in range(30000):
    ev.append(["enqueue", i, 1, 100, (i * 7919) % 100000])
    if i % 500 == 0:
        ev.append(["save", (i // 500) % 64])
    if i % 500 == 250:
        ev.append(["restore", (i // 500) % 64])
for j in range(20000):
    ev.append(["restore", j % 64])
    ev.append(["dequeue", 1])
req = {"runs":[dict(banks=2, load_balancers=2, fifo_bytes=2**31-1, pifo_bytes=2**31-1,
    refill_batch=32, sample_period=100000, borders=[0,50000], policy={"kind":"sff"}, events=ev)]}
data = json.dumps(req).encode()
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B','/workspace/submission/cli.py'], input=data, capture_output=True, cwd='/workspace')
print("rc", p.returncode, "outlen", len(p.stdout))
print("STDERR:", p.stderr.decode()[-2000:])
